ber1-edge.description: WAN edge: NAT from the WAN-DMZ VLAN to the rack VLANs, tailnet subnet router, uplink for the management switch

ber1-svc.description: Service node: DHCP, DNS, NTP, PXE for the rack, image mirror later, second tailnet subnet router

ber1-store-a.description: Kura region ber1, replica A. Joins the workload cluster, so its disk layout is fixed at install time

ber1-store-b.description: Kura region ber1, replica B. Colo only; the prep bay has no second storage node
